(2022)"}</_components.a>{" propose an approach to eliminate manual efforts by leveraging LLMs with \"Let's think step by step\" prompt to generate reasoning chains for demonstrations one by one. This work proposes Auto-CoT, which samples questions with diversity and generates reasoning chains to construct the demonstrations."}</_components.p>{"\n"}<_components.p>{"Auto-CoT consists of two main stages:"}</_components.p>{"\n"}<_components.ul>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"Stage 1): "}<_components.strong>{"question clustering"}</_components.strong>{": partition questions of a given dataset into a few clusters"}</_components.li>{"\n"}<_components.li>{"Stage 2): "}<_components.strong>{"demonstration sampling"}</_components.strong>{": select a representative question from each cluster and generate its reasoning chain using Zero-Shot-CoT with simple heuristics"}</_components.li>{"\n"}</_components.ul>{"\n"}<_components.p>{"The simple heuristics could be length of questions (e.g., 60 tokens) and number of steps in rationale (e.g., 5 reasoning steps).
